about: [C4] The diner's street door tried at every moment of II (docs/story/briefs/C4_FIGHT.md, Proofs: 'The door: try it at every moment of the chapter'), by real input from ?start=fight: in the lesson's first moment while the room still clears (not barred yet: they are going out by it - I stay inside, the leaf never in me), in the lesson once the bar is down, in rounds 1 to 3 and in the reel (each beat jumped to with G.scenes.go), and after the last blow. In a fist fight W walks at him and A / D are slips, so the play puts me a pace inside the doorway and him a pace further in, and I back into the door with S, away from him (real keys). The way in itself is not mine to move; after the last blow fight_out walks into it and fight_door pulls and pushes it. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/fight_tries.json
